newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Rizal Bank Q3 net loss 159.3 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Rizal Bank Q3 net loss 159.3 mln pesos.

text.p: Rizal Commercial Banking Corp said on Friday it recorded a net loss of 159.3 million pesos in the quarter ended September 30.

In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the bank said it had total operating income for the quarter of 1.579 billion pesos and operating expenses of 1.703 billion pesos, resulting in a net operating loss of 124 million pesos.
Its income statement showed it made a reversal on other income in the amount of 427.231 million pesos. A bank official attributed this to "wrong booking" which she did not elaborate.
The bank did not make available comparative figures for last year as well as figures for the first nine months.
The bank reported a full year 1995 net profit of 1.402 billion pesos. - Manila newsroom 63 2 841-8937 fax 8176267
